lines.q: Thirty-five questions. If you get twenty-five right, your memory is excellent. How many days are in a leap year?
What is the largest ocean on Earth?
Who painted the Mona Lisa?
How many continents are there?
Water freezes at how many degrees Fahrenheit?
Which band sang Hey Jude?
Which planet is called the Red Planet?
In which city is the Statue of Liberty?
Who was the first man to walk on the Moon?
In which year did the Titanic sink?
What is the hardest natural substance?
Who was known as the King of Rock and Roll?
What is the longest river in Africa?
Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?
Which nineteen thirty-nine film features Dorothy and her dog Toto?
How many players per team are on a football pitch?
Which gas do plants absorb from the air?
Which instrument has eighty-eight keys?
lines.a: The piano! If you're enjoying this, subscribe and turn on the bell!

lines.q: Who was Britain's prime minister for most of World War Two?
In which year did World War One begin?
What is the smallest country in the world?
Which metal gets its chemical symbol from the Latin word ferrum?
Who had the big hit Respect in nineteen sixty-seven?
lines.a: Aretha Franklin! The Queen of Soul.

lines.q: Who was the American president during the Moon landing?
What is the largest hot desert in the world?
Who discovered penicillin in nineteen twenty-eight?
Which painter cut off part of his own ear?
In which year did Elvis Presley die?
Who was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize?
What is the longest bone in the human body?
Which country has the most people today?
lines.a: India! It passed China in twenty twenty-three.

lines.q: Who composed the Moonlight Sonata?
Which film won the very first Best Picture Oscar?
In which year was President Kennedy assassinated?
Final question. Which mountain is the tallest from base to peak?
lines.a: Mauna Kea! Most of it is under the sea.

outroLine: How many did you get? Comment your score below, and subscribe with the bell on for a new quiz every day!
